description.name: get_api_operation

description.name: api_status
description.description: Check authenticated Cannon Studio account/API connectivity before estimating or creating requests. Requires OAuth or a developer API key; may update key/token usage metadata, but does not spend credits, enqueue jobs, change assets, or expose secrets.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_offerings, get_checkout_link · Private data: fetch, api_status, estimate_generation_cost, create_generation_request, get_generation_request · Public sink: get_generation_request · Destructive: create_generation_request, get_generation_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_offerings, get_checkout_link · Private data: fetch, api_status, estimate_generation_cost, create_generation_request, get_generation_request · Public sink: get_generation_request · Destructive: create_generation_request, get_generation_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

description: Page through your owned worlds with titles, descriptions, media, and direct links. Returns a next_cursor when more worlds exist.

description.name: get_world
description.description: Read an owned world's summary and media. Use list_world_assets to inspect its library and list_creator_flow_projects for project discovery.

description.name: create_world
description.description: Create an owned world with title, description, genre, visual style, lore, and production cues. No media generation or credit spend.

description.name: update_world
description.description: Update an owned world's descriptive fields. Omitted fields remain unchanged; empty strings/arrays clear optional fields. Does not rewrite existing media.

description.name: delete_world
description.description: Preview world deletion including its project count. After explicit approval, supply dry_run=false, confirmed=true, expected_title. Deletes world projects/stories/relationships and detaches reusable assets using the app's deletion service.

description.name: list_world_assets
description.description: Discover asset kinds, then page through owned characters, locations, objects, outfits, abilities, or cameras. Select kind; optionally filter world_id. Returns asset IDs, descriptions, media links, and next_cursor.

description.name: get_world_asset
description.description: Read one owned library asset's descriptive state and media. Use the kind and world_id from discovery; locations may be world-scoped.

description.name: create_world_asset
description.description: Create a reusable owned character, location, object, outfit, ability, or camera from descriptive fields and optional existing HTTPS media references. Does not generate or download media and spends no credits.

description.name: update_world_asset
description.description: Edit an owned reusable asset's descriptive fields and existing media references using the app's asset service. Does not generate new media.

description.name: delete_world_asset
description.description: Preview an owned library asset deletion. Only after explicit approval set dry_run=false, confirmed=true, expected_title. Existing projects may lose references to the deleted asset.
